archetypes.name: contract-sync
archetypes.rationale: The plan spans script behavior, sibling contracts, SKILL prose, admission docs, and summary text where stale publish-gated wording is the main defect risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether every proposed contract and operator-facing text update matches the new design-publish ordering and gates. Look for stale claims that [DESIGNED] waits on full log publish, that reentry markers occur before publish, or that failed-publish always means implement admission is ready. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: scrub-gate
archetypes.rationale: Early admission before log publishing creates a security-sensitive dependency on the new scrub-only gate being correctly specified and tested.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check the plan for gaps between the intended fail-closed secret-scrub preflight and the actual design-log-publish.sh surfaces it proposes to reuse. Verify that scrub-only semantics, SCRUB_OK parsing, SECRET_SCRUB_VIOLATIONS handling, and rename gating are all pinned against repo evidence without accidentally bypassing existing scrub protections. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: admission-flow
archetypes.rationale: The proposed change deliberately alters the /design to /implement handoff, so lifecycle-title admission and failure-footers need targeted plan scrutiny.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace the proposed [DESIGNING] to [DESIGNED] lifecycle handoff against the implement admission documentation and design-route reentry behavior. Look for plan holes where rename failure, scrub failure, publish failure, or already-designed recovery could leave operators with incorrect next steps. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
